svg.title: Agent execution inside a session turn
svg.desc: Session delegates conversation, query, retrieval selection, and its operation to AgentHarness. The harness prepares policy, tool schemas, a cached system prompt, and conversation context. FunctionAgent chooses calls to permitted tools; their model-facing results feed subsequent decisions. The harness handles final evidence checks, optionally reconstructs sources, and emits chat.completed with a transcript available for Session to commit separately. Workflow events are translated to operation events throughout, not only at the end.

g.text: Session delegates an agent run
Conversation + query + retrieval selection + existing operation
AgentHarness prepares the run
AgentPolicy → actual tool schemas and bound wrappers
System prompt + preferences → cached prompt bundle
Conversation context task → history, compacted when needed
FunctionAgent · model execution
Choose a tool call or an answer.
Use the result to decide what comes next.
Tools run sequentially; the chain is not fixed.
Permitted tool wrappers
Retrieval · navigation · memory · preferences
Run the component; return model-facing data.
Recoverable error → corrective next_action.
Final response + accumulated evidence
Knowledge-content tool attempted, but no evidence obtained?
Substitute a safe insufficient-evidence response; otherwise keep the answer.
Optional source reconstruction
With evidence: reconstruct files and publish them. Without it: skip this work.
chat.completed + completed transcript
Session then commits the turn separately; agent completion is not that commit.
Throughout: workflow → event translator → thinking / response / tool activity in the operation stream
